name: Volumetric Box
description: A box as a signed distance field, with optionally rounded edges.

inputParameters.name: plane
inputParameters.description: The box's frame, at its centre. Defaults to world XY.

inputParameters.name: xsize
inputParameters.description: Size along the frame's X axis.

inputParameters.name: ysize
inputParameters.description: Size along Y. Defaults to xsize.

inputParameters.name: zsize
inputParameters.description: Size along Z. Defaults to xsize.

inputParameters.name: radius
inputParameters.description: Edge fillet radius. 0 leaves the edges sharp.

outputParameters.name: vol
outputParameters.description: A volumetric object, to combine or to mesh.
